mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generation_user_quota(user_id, active_tasks) VALUES (#{userId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_user_quota SET active_tasks = active_tasks - 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active_tasks > 0
mapper.select: SELECT active_tasks FROM generation_user_quota WHERE user_id = #{userId}
